_comment: DELEGATE-BEARING stand-in for the run-time-staged `pw_reg.json`, used ONLY by test/DeployGuards.t.sol so `script/DeployWalletSettlement.s.sol` can be EXECUTED inside `forge test` against the shape that matters: a channel whose LIVE state has delegates (the wallet demo's own `wallet-live-work/chN/channel_snapshot.json` reaches that script with `delegateCount = 2`). The committed `pw_reg.json` has no delegates, so it cannot distinguish the fixed script from the conflated one. Schema-identical to what `channel_member deploy-settlement` writes: `member_count` co-signing members FIRST, then `active_delegate_count` delegates, in every array. `reg_delegate_count` is the L1 REGISTRATION record's count and is always 0 (cosigner-only registration is a circuit constraint, `channel_reg_step.rs`); `active_delegate_count` is the LIVE count the settlement manager binds (B-2 close floor + delegate recipient bindings). The key material is arbitrary but must satisfy IntmaxRollup.registerChannel and the manager constructor: pairwise-distinct nonzero pk_gs, nonzero regev digests, distinct nonzero recipients, bp_member_slot < member_count. NOT a proving artifact: the script it feeds wires an always-true mock MLE verifier.
